title: Research Translation Studio
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting research translation studio to the research-translation argument trace (finding to principle to decision to evidence to disclosed revision), reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Assemble a complete translation chain: finding to principle to design decision to evidence to disclosed revision
Locate the broken link in an argument where a finding is cited but never changes a decision, or a decision is made but never tested
Reject decorative citations that do not alter any design choice
Show that each design decision traces backward to a source and forward to evidence

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
